goal: Green npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo with server/ and web/ packages, shared domain/event types, and all tooling scripts wired
summary: Phase 1 delivered a green npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo for Togezer: root package.json (workspaces server+web, engines node>=22, type module, scripts dev/build/test/typecheck/lint — test = root `vitest run` over server+web projects, typecheck = direct `tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p web`), .gitignore, strict tsconfig.base.json, root vitest.config.ts (projects: server, web); server/ (express 5.2.1, ws 8.21.3, tsx, vitest 5, NodeNext tsconfig) with canonical server/src/types.ts (Agent/Task/Goal/Lesson + WsEvent union + StateSnapshot + WS_EVENT_TYPES with compile-time exhaustiveness guard); web/ (react 19, vite 8, vitest 5 + jsdom/testing-library) with thin type-only re-export of the contract; tooling wired (vitest configs in both packages, eslint flat config with documented TS7 side-by-side alias pattern, Vite proxy /goals|/state|/agents|/lessons|/ws -> :3001, placeholder /health server, sanity tests). Verified after remediation: npm test exit 0 (2 files, 3 tests, projects togezer-server/togezer-web), npm run typecheck exit 0, npm run lint exit 0, npm install exit 0, boot smoke GET /health -> {"ok":true} on :3001, vite/8.3.1 runs.
stepSummaries:
1. Create root package.json (workspaces: server, web; scripts: dev, build, test, typecheck, lint), .gitignore (node_modules, dist, *.db), tsconfig.base.json (strict), and package.json + tsconfig for server/ (Express, ws, tsx, vitest) and web/ (Vite, React, vitest) with dependencies pinned [verified]
  2. Define shared domain contracts in server/src/types.ts: Agent {id,name,role,status}, Task {id,goalId,title,role,status,assigneeId,result?}, Goal {id,text,status}, Lesson {id,content,sourceTaskId,createdAt}, and the WsEvent discriminated union (task.updated, agent.status, lesson.created, goal.status); export a types-only surface the web package also consumes [verified]
  3. Wire tooling end-to-end: vitest configs in both packages, minimal eslint flat config, dev scripts (tsx watch for server, vite for web), and placeholder src/index.ts entry points so every script runs [verified]
